name: Inma Rankou ~Choukyou Sennou
source:
Low--ranking succubus Azel escaped hell.
Disguised as Morio Azami she mingled with human society, suckling the energy from their souls in secret.
Her name was similar to the famous demon Azazel, but the similarity ended there.
Azel's only power was that she could turn brainwash other women into horny nymphomaniacs.
So she hid in plain sight as a human, evading the holy demon hunter who was looking for her...
This was life now! Azel disguised as a human, making a harem of crazy sexpots. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE128125.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
低阶魅魔阿泽尔逃离了地狱。
她伪装成阿扎见森夫混入人类社会，秘密吸取人类灵魂的能量。
她的名字与著名的恶魔阿撒兹勒相似，但相似之处也就到此为止了。
阿泽尔唯一的能力是她可以将其他女性洗脑成性欲旺盛的色情狂。
于是她以人类的身份躲在众目睽睽之下，躲避正在寻找她的圣魔猎手……
这就是现在的生活！阿泽尔伪装成人类，组建了一群疯狂的性感女郎。
